metricDefinitions.meanInteractivity: 1 / mean TPOT, output tokens/s/user; unchanged original formal metric.
metricDefinitions.totalThroughput: Logical input plus output tokens/s across physical GPUs; cached input included.
metricDefinitions.throughput: Total input plus output throughput per physical GPU; shared GPU sets are not added.
metricDefinitions.ttft: Mean source-clock TTFT in seconds; no frontend wall-time overhead or percentile inferred.
metricDefinitions.endToEnd: Mean source-clock request E2E seconds; excluded prefix preparation and warm-up.

provenance.publicationScope: Owner-authorized selected performance/configuration metadata; private PerfDB payloads, raw ledgers, machine paths and infrastructure excluded.
provenance.simulationDateLabel: 20261101, corrected display date; current-main reproduction completed 2026-11-01.
provenance.SGLangBudgetPatch: 82 points honor the original finite physical coordinator wait budget; virtual costs/protocol unchanged. 80 completed points retain the original source.
provenance.limitations: Four cold workloads match reference lengths. Fourteen cached workloads are nominal comparisons only: simulation ISL is total, reference context is prefix. Original real-run compile-stall flags and historical curves remain separate. Golden acceptance and sampling differ; no matched-recipe accuracy or blind holdout pass is claimed.
